content.text:
This confirms the history clearly. Commit `9ec710b` (Oct 29, 2013) is the only commit between file creation and the fix that touches this line — it introduced `EnvVars env = context.getBuild().getEnvironment();` into `InverseBuildChooser.java`, which is exactly the line reverted by the bug-fix commit `88ddc23`.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 9ec710b2c1122df901da5c33c5b1c6df47eb3e36

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log` on `InverseBuildChooser.java` to find every commit that touched the file, then used `git show` on each candidate to see which one added the `context.getBuild().getEnvironment()` line that `88ddc23` removes. Only one commit, `9ec710b`, added that exact line (it added branch-spec environment-variable expansion support: `spec.matches(branch.getName(), env)`). I also traced the history of `BuildChooserContext.java` to understand the `getBuild()`/`getEnvironment()` API evolution.

**(2) The introduced bug:** `9ec710b` added `EnvVars env = context.getBuild().getEnvironment();` to `InverseBuildChooser.getCandidateRevisions()`. The problem is that `context.getBuild()` can be `null` — during SCM polling, `GitSCM` constructs the `BuildChooserContext` as `new BuildChooserContextImpl(project, null, ...)` (no build exists yet since polling happens before/without triggering a build). Calling `.getEnvironment()` on a null `AbstractBuild` throws a `NullPointerException`, breaking polling for jobs using the `InverseBuildChooser`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** The exact same anti-pattern (`context.getBuild().getEnvironment()`) was independently introduced into the sibling class `DefaultBuildChooser.java` by commit `92728ef` (Jan 27, 2014). That copy was fixed on Feb 17, 2014 by commit `d162f31`, which added a proper `getEnvironment()` method directly to the `BuildChooserContext` interface/implementation (backed by an `EnvVars` field populated even when `build` is `null`) and rewired `DefaultBuildChooser` to use `context.getEnvironment()` instead. However, `d162f31` only fixed `DefaultBuildChooser` and missed the identical bug in `InverseBuildChooser`. The commit under investigation, `88ddc23` (Mar 5, 2014), completes that fix by applying the same `context.getEnvironment()` change to `InverseBuildChooser`, using the API that `d162f31` had already introduced. This strongly confirms `9ec710b` as the origin of the bug pattern in `InverseBuildChooser.java`.

I'm confident in this attribution — the fix is a clean revert of a single line added by exactly one prior commit, and the parallel history in `DefaultBuildChooser`/`BuildChooserContext` independently corroborates the root cause (calling `.getEnvironment()` on a potentially-null build during polling).
